info.title: DevFlow API
info.description: REST API for DevFlow, a sprint-based issue tracker. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details; see docs/INTEGRATION.md for the error catalogue and integration contract. Every endpoint except the health checks is rate-limited per client and answers 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After when a limit is reached (limits: docs/INTEGRATION.md §4.1).

post.description: Called by GitHub, not by the frontend. Authenticated by `X-Hub-Signature-256` (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET); returns 404 when the integration is not configured. Issue keys (DEV-104) are read from PR titles, branch names and commit messages. A pull request links itself to those issues (`git.kind = pr`), a merged one moves them to the project's first done status, and one closed without merging removes its link. A commit links issues that have no pull request link. Changes are broadcast over Live Sync with `actorId: null`. Deliveries change issues only in the workspace their installation is linked to; deliveries from unlinked installations are acknowledged with 202. Handles `ping`, `pull_request`, `push` and `installation` (uninstalling unlinks); other events are acknowledged with 202.

get.description: Admins only, signed-in session only; navigate the browser here, not fetch. Sets a short-lived state cookie and redirects to GitHub's install page; GitHub comes back through /api/integrations/github/setup, which redirects to {CORS_ORIGIN}{redirect}. redirect is a relative frontend path (default /projects). 404 when the integration is not configured; 403 DEMO_WORKSPACE_LOCKED in the demo workspace.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: too many requests from this client. Retry after Retry-After seconds.

delete.description: Admins only, signed-in session only. Its deliveries stop changing this workspace; the App stays installed on GitHub (uninstall it there to remove it). 404 when it is not linked here; 403 DEMO_WORKSPACE_LOCKED.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: too many requests from this client. Retry after Retry-After seconds.
